# Lift Ease

> Lift Ease (Lift Ease Pty Ltd, ABN 64 689 763 335) supplies, installs and services full home elevators and commercial DDA lifts. We mainly work across Victoria (Melbourne), and also service parts of New South Wales, South Australia and Tasmania. Showroom: 61 Slater Parade, Keilor East VIC 3033. Phone 1300 810 147.

Key facts:
- Home elevators typically cost $36,000 to $100,000+, depending on lift type, levels served, shaft, cabin size and finish. Final pricing follows a site assessment.
- Factory backed 5 Year Parts Warranty (parts only) on full elevators (Vector Pro, Zenith Ultra, Atlus, Zenith DDA, E1, RB150); 2 years on Levare compact lifts.
- All Lift Ease units are machine-room-less: no model needs a machine room.
- Elevators are built to AS 1735; commercial lifts are DDA compliant.
- All home elevators run on single phase 230VAC; only the E1 needs three phase.
- Showroom open Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm (book online); Saturdays by appointment only.

## Home elevators
- [Vector Pro](https://www.liftease.com.au/vector-pro): hydraulic home elevator, 120 mm pit, up to 10 m travel and 4 stops, 400 kg (5 person), cabins 750 × 700 to 1100 × 1350 mm, no machine room, 1–2 week install. [Specs](https://www.liftease.com.au/specs/vector-pro)
- [Zenith Ultra](https://www.liftease.com.au/zenith-ultra): home version of the Zenith, advanced belt-drive, machine-room-less, up to 15 m and 6 levels (G+5), 150–300 mm pit, 450 kg (6 person), cabins 1000 × 1200 and 1100 × 1400 mm. [Specs](https://www.liftease.com.au/specs/zenith-ultra)
- [Atlus](https://www.liftease.com.au/products/atlus): electric hybrid screw drive, machine-room-less, 50–150 mm pit, 400 kg (5 person), 0.15–0.30 m/s, no oil, battery backup, touch screen standard. [Specs](https://www.liftease.com.au/specs/atlus)
- [Levare Compact](https://www.liftease.com.au/levare-compact) and [Levare Plus](https://www.liftease.com.au/levare-plus): shaft-less compact home lifts, about 2 day install.

## Commercial and DDA lifts
- [Zenith DDA](https://www.liftease.com.au/zenith-dda): public-use version of the Zenith, electric traction, machine-room-less, up to 10 levels (G+9), 1100 × 1400 mm car, 0.3–1.0 m/s. [Specs](https://www.liftease.com.au/specs/zenith-dda)
- [E1](https://www.liftease.com.au/e1): VVVF traction, 1.0–2.0 m/s, up to 2,500 kg, up to 35 m travel, three phase.
- [RB150](https://www.liftease.com.au/rb150): access platform lift, 600–3,000 mm lifting height.
- [Commercial & DDA lifts](https://www.liftease.com.au/commercial-lifts): offices, medical, schools, retail, apartments, aged care.
- [Lifts for builders](https://www.liftease.com.au/lp/builders): pit depths, install times, shaft options and servicing for new builds in Victoria.
- [Lifts for architects & designers](https://www.liftease.com.au/lp/architects): bespoke sizing, custom interiors, glass towers, door types and spec sheets.

## Services
- [Elevator servicing](https://www.liftease.com.au/elevator-servicing): servicing and repairs for home and commercial lifts, including hydraulic, traction, screw, belt and pneumatic lifts. Email service@liftease.com.au.
- [Funding](https://www.liftease.com.au/funding): NDIS home modifications and Support at Home (AT-HM, up to $15,390) for eligible people.
